title: 6 December 1961: Live: Cavern Club, Liverpool (evening)
content:
The Beatles’ 31st evening show at the Cavern Club took place on this date.

Overall this was their 92nd appearance at the underground Mathew Street venue, including their more common lunchtime shows.

The precise number of The Beatles’ Cavern performances is not known, although they played at least 155 lunchtime and 125 evening shows between 9 February 1961 and 3 August 1963.
